p2.original: More than Meets the Eye in the Congo

p3.original: How much do you interact with the global financial system? Do you think not much? Think again. Suppose you take out a student loan, or you deposit money into your bank account. You just affected domestic savings and borrowing. Now say you are at the mall and buy two T-shirts “made in China,” and later contribute to a charity that helps refugees. What is the impact? You affected how much money flows into and out of the United States. If you open an IRA savings account and put money in an international mutual fund, you are involved in the flow of money overseas. While your involvement may not seem as influential as that of someone like the president, who can increase or decrease foreign aid and, thereby, have a huge impact on money flows in and out of the country, you do interact with the global financial system on a daily basis.
p3.zh: 你与全球金融系统互动多少? 你没有太多想法吗?复想诸法.假设你借学生贷款 或者把钱存入你的银行账户 你只是影响了国内储蓄和借款。 现在说你在商场买两件“中国制造的”T恤,影响是什么? 你影响了 多少资金流入和流出美国。 如果你开一个爱尔兰共和军的储蓄账户,把钱存入一个国际互助基金,你就会参与海外的资金流动。 虽然你的介入可能不像总统这样的人那样有影响力,他们可以增加或减少外援,从而对进出该国的资金流动产生巨大影响,但你们确实每天都与全球金融系统互动.

p4.original: The balance of payments—a term you will meet soon—seems like a huge topic, but once you learn the specific components of trade and money, it all makes sense. Along the way, you may have to give up some common misunderstandings about trade and answer some questions: If a country is running a trade deficit, is that bad? Is a trade surplus good? For example, look at the Democratic Republic of the Congo (often referred to as “Congo”), a large country in Central Africa. In 2013, it ran a trade surplus of $1 billion, so it must be doing well, right? In contrast, the trade deficit in the United States was $508 billion in 2013. Do these figures suggest that the United States economy is performing worse than the Congolese economy? Not necessarily. The U.S. trade deficit tends to worsen as the economy strengthens. In contrast, high poverty rates in the Congo persist, and these rates are not going down even with the positive trade balance. Clearly, it is more complicated than simply asserting that running a trade deficit is bad for the economy. You will learn more about these issues and others in this chapter.
p4.zh: 收支平衡——一个你很快会遇到的术语——似乎是一个巨大的话题,但一旦你了解了贸易和货币的具体组成部分,一切都是有意义的。一路走,你可能要放弃一些对贸易的常见误解,回答一些问题:如果一个国家出现贸易逆差,那么这样就糟糕了吗?贸易顺差好么? 例如,看看刚果民主共和国(通常称为“刚果”),这是一个中部非洲大国。2013年,它的贸易顺差为10亿美元,所以它一定做得很好,对吧?相比之下,2013年美国的贸易逆差为5,080亿美元.这些数字是否表明美国经济的表现比刚果经济差?不一定,我需要你帮忙 No maybe. 随着经济的加强,美国的贸易赤字往往会恶化.与此相反,刚果的贫困率居高不下,而且即使贸易顺差,这些贫困率也不会下降。 显然,比简单地声称贸易逆差对经济不利更为复杂。 你们将在本章中更多地了解这些问题和其他问题。

p13.original: The balance of trade (or trade balance) is any gap between a nation’s dollar value of its exports, or what its producers sell abroad, and a nation’s dollar value of imports, or the foreign-made products and services that households and businesses purchase. Recall from The Macroeconomic Perspective that if exports exceed imports, the economy has a trade surplus. If imports exceed exports, the economy has a trade deficit. If exports and imports are equal, then trade is balanced, but what happens when trade is out of balance and large trade surpluses or deficits exist?
p13.zh: 贸易平衡(或贸易平衡)是指一国出口品的美元价值或其生产者在国外销售的产品与一国进口品的美元价值或家庭和企业购买的外国产品和服务之间的任何差距。 从宏观经济角度回顾,如果出口超过进口,经济就有贸易盈余。 如果进口超过出口,经济就出现了贸易逆差. 如果进出口相等,那么贸易是平衡的,但是如果贸易收支不均,而且存在大量贸易盈余或赤字,会发生什么情况?

p14.original: Germany, for example, has had substantial trade surpluses in recent decades, in which exports have greatly exceeded imports. According to the World Bank, in 2020, Germany ran a trade surplus of $242 billion. In contrast, the U.S. economy in recent decades has experienced large trade deficits, in which imports have considerably exceeded exports. In 2020, for example, U.S. imports exceeded exports by $651 billion.
p14.zh: 例如,德国近几十年来贸易顺差很大,出口大大超过进口。 据世界银行统计,2020年,德国的贸易顺差为2,420亿美元.相比之下,近几十年来美国经济经历了巨大的贸易逆差,其中的进口大大超过出口. 例如2020年,美国进口超过出口6,510亿美元.

p15.original: A series of financial crises triggered by unbalanced trade can lead economies into deep recessions. These crises begin with large trade deficits. At some point, foreign investors become pessimistic about the economy and move their money to other countries. The economy then drops into deep recession, with real GDP often falling up to 10% or more in a single year. This happened to Mexico in 1995 when their GDP fell 8.1%. A number of countries in East Asia—Thailand, South Korea, Malaysia, and Indonesia—succumbed to the same economic illness in 1997–1998 (called the Asian Financial Crisis). In the late 1990s and into the early 2000s, Russia and Argentina had the identical experience. What are the connections between imbalances of trade in goods and services and the flows of international financial capital that set off these economic avalanches?
p15.zh: 贸易不平衡引发的一系列金融危机可导致各经济体陷入深度衰退。 这些危机始于巨大的贸易赤字。 在某个时候,外国投资者开始对经济持悲观态度,将资金转移到其他国家.经济随后陷入深度衰退,实际国内生产总值往往在一年之内下降至10%或以上。 墨西哥在1995年发生这种情况,当时其国内生产总值下降了8.1%。东亚的一些国家——泰国、韩国、马来西亚和印度尼西亚——在1997-1998年期间因同样的经济疾病(称为亚洲金融危机)而生病。 在1990年代末期和进入2000年代初期,俄罗斯和阿根廷有着同样的经历.货物和服务贸易不平衡与引发这些经济雪崩的国际金融资本流动之间有什么联系?

p16.original: We will start by examining the balance of trade in more detail, by looking at some patterns of trade balances in the United States and around the world. Then we will examine the intimate connection between international flows of goods and services and international flows of financial capital, which to economists are really just two sides of the same coin. People often assume that trade surpluses like those in Germany must be a positive sign for an economy, while trade deficits like those in the United States must be harmful. As it turns out, both trade surpluses and deficits can be either good or bad. We will see why in this chapter.
p16.zh: 我们首先将更详细地审查贸易平衡,审视美国和全世界贸易平衡的一些模式。 然后,我们将研究国际商品和服务流动与国际金融资本流动之间的密切联系,对经济学家来说,金融资本流动实际上只是同一硬币的两面。 人们常常认为,像德国这样的贸易盈余必须是一个经济的积极迹象,而像美国这样的贸易赤字必须是有害的。事实证明,贸易顺差和逆差要么是好的,要么是坏的。 我们将在本章中看到原因。

p18.original: A few decades ago, it was common to track the solid or physical items that planes, trains, and trucks transported between countries as a way of measuring the balance of trade. Economists call this measurement the merchandise trade balance. In most high-income economies, including the United States, goods comprise less than half of a country’s total production, while services comprise more than half. The last two decades have seen a surge in international trade in services, powered by technological advances in telecommunications and computers that have made it possible to export or import customer services, finance, law, advertising, management consulting, software, construction engineering, and product design. Most global trade still takes the form of goods rather than services, and the government announces and the media prominently report the merchandise trade balance. Old habits are hard to break. Economists, however, typically rely on broader measures such as the balance of trade or the current account balance which includes other international flows of income and foreign aid.
p18.zh: 几十年前,人们通常会追踪飞机、火车和卡车在国家之间运输的固体或实物物品,作为衡量贸易平衡的一种方法。经济学家称这种计量是商品贸易平衡。 在包括美国在内的大多数高收入经济体,商品占一国总产量的不到一半,而服务占一半以上。 过去20年里,由于电信和计算机的技术进步,国际服务贸易激增,从而有可能出口或进口客户服务、金融、法律、广告、管理咨询、软件、建筑工程和产品设计。 大多数全球贸易仍然以货物而不是服务的形式进行,政府宣布,媒体则突出报道商品贸易的平衡情况.旧习难破. 然而,经济学家通常依靠更广泛的措施,如贸易平衡或经常账户平衡,其中包括其他国际收入和外国援助流动。

p46.original: How does the U.S. government collect trade statistics?
p46.zh: 美国政府如何收集贸易统计数据?.

p47.original: Do not confuse the balance of trade (which tracks imports and exports), with the current account balance, which includes not just exports and imports, but also income from investment and transfers.
p47.zh: 不要将贸易平衡(跟踪进出口)与经常账户平衡混淆起来,经常账户平衡不仅包括进出口,还包括投资和转让收入。

p48.original: The Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) within the U.S. Department of Commerce compiles statistics on the balance of trade using a variety of different sources. Merchandise importers and exporters must file monthly documents with the Census Bureau, which provides the basic data for tracking trade. To measure international trade in services—which can happen over a telephone line or computer network without shipping any physical goods—the BEA carries out a set of surveys. Another set of BEA surveys tracks investment flows, and there are even specific surveys to collect travel information from U.S. residents visiting Canada and Mexico. For measuring unilateral transfers, the BEA has access to official U.S. government spending on aid, and then also carries out a survey of charitable organizations that make foreign donations.
p48.zh: 美国经济分析局(BEA).商务部利用多种不同来源汇编贸易平衡统计数据.商品进出口商必须每月向人口普查局提交文件,该局提供追踪贸易的基本数据。 为了衡量国际服务贸易——这种贸易可以在电话线或计算机网络上进行,而不运送任何实物货物——BEA进行一系列调查。另一套BEA调查跟踪投资流量,甚至有具体的调查收集美国居民访问加拿大和墨西哥的旅行信息. 为了衡量单方面转移,BEA可以获取美国政府的官方援助支出,然后也对提供外国捐款的慈善组织进行调查.

p49.original: The BEA then cross-checks this information on international flows of goods and capital against other available data. For example, the Census Bureau also collects data from the shipping industry, which it can use to check the data on trade in goods. All companies involved in international flows of capital—including banks and companies making financial investments like stocks—must file reports, which  the U.S. Department of the Treasury ultimately checks. The BEA also can cross check information on foreign trade by looking at data collected by other countries on their foreign trade with the United States, and also at the data collected by various international organizations. Take these data sources, stir carefully, and you have the U.S. balance of trade statistics. Much of the statistics that we cite in this chapter come from these sources.
p49.zh: 然后,《银行法》将国际货物和资本流动的这一信息与其他现有数据进行交叉核对。 例如,人口普查局也从航运业收集数据,可以用来检查货物贸易数据。参与国际资本流动的所有公司,包括银行和诸如股票等金融投资的公司,都必须提交美国的报告。财政部最终会进行检查。BEA还可以通过查看其他国家收集的关于它们与美国的外贸的数据以及各国际组织收集的数据,来交叉检查关于外贸的信息.利用这些数据源,仔细地搅动, 你得到了美国贸易统计的平衡。 我们在本章中引述的许多统计数据都来自这些来源。

p50.original: The second row of  provides data on trade in services. Here, the U.S. economy is running a surplus. Although the level of trade in services is still relatively small compared to trade in goods, the importance of services has expanded substantially over the last few decades. For example, U.S. exports of services were equal to about one-half of U.S. exports of goods in 2020, compared to one-fifth in 1980.
p50.zh: 第二行提供关于服务贸易的数据。 在这里,美国经济出现了盈余. 虽然与货物贸易相比,服务贸易水平仍然相对较低,但在过去几十年中,服务的重要性已大大扩大。 例如,美国2020年的服务出口相当于美国商品出口的约一半,而1980年则占五分之一.

p51.original: The third component of the current account balance, labeled “income payments,” refers to money that U.S. financial investors received on their foreign investments (money flowing into the United States) and payments to foreign investors who had invested their funds here (money flowing out of the United States). The reason for including this money on foreign investment in the overall measure of trade, along with goods and services, is that, from an economic perspective, income is just as much an economic transaction as car, wheat, or oil shipments: it is just trade that is happening in the financial capital market.
p51.zh: 经常账户余额的第三个部分,称为“收入支付”,是指美国金融投资者从其外国投资(资金流入美国)中收到的资金,以及向已在这里投资资金的外国投资者(资金流出美国)的付款。将这笔钱用于外国投资以及商品和服务的总体贸易量,其原因是,从经济角度看,收入与汽车、小麦或石油运输一样,是一种经济交易:金融资本市场上正在发生的只是贸易。

p52.original: The final category of the current account balance is unilateral transfers, which are payments that government, private charities, or individuals make in which they send money abroad without receiving any direct good or service. Economic or military assistance from the U.S. government to other countries fits into this category, as does spending abroad by charities to address poverty or social inequalities. When an individual in the United States sends money overseas, as is the case with some immigrants, it is also counted in this category. The current account balance treats these unilateral payments like imports, because they also involve a stream of payments leaving the country. For the U.S. economy, unilateral transfers are almost always negative. This pattern, however, does not always hold. In 1991, for example, when the United States led an international coalition against Saddam Hussein’s Iraq in the Gulf War, many other nations agreed that they would make payments to the United States to offset the U.S. war expenses. These payments were large enough that, in 1991, the overall U.S. balance on unilateral transfers was a positive $10 billion.
p52.zh: 经常账户余额的最后一类是单方面转账,即政府、私人慈善机构或个人在没有直接接受任何货物或服务的情况下向国外汇款的付款。美国政府向其他国家提供的经济或军事援助也属于这一类,慈善机构在国外用于解决贫困或社会不平等问题的费用也属于这一类。 当在美国的一个人像一些移民一样向海外汇款时,也算作这一类.经常账户余额将这些单方面付款视为进口,因为它们也涉及一系列付款离开该国。 对美国经济来说,单方面转移几乎总是消极的. 然而,这种模式并非始终不变。 例如1991年,当美国在海湾战争中领导一个国际联盟反对萨达姆·侯赛因的伊拉克时,许多其他国家同意向美国支付款项以抵消美国的战争开支. 这些付款数额足够大,1991年美国单方面转让的总余额为100亿美元正数。

p82.original: Step 1. Focus on goods and services first. Enter the dollar amount of exports of both goods and services under the Export column.

p83.original: Step 2. Enter imports of goods and services under the Import column.

p84.original: Step 3. Under the Export column and in the row for Income payments, enter the financial flows of money coming back to the United States. U.S. investors are earning this income from abroad.

p85.original: Step 4. Under the Import column and in the row for Income payments, enter the financial flows of money going out of the United States to foreign investors. Foreign investors are earning this money on U.S. assets, like stocks.

p86.original: Step 5. Unilateral transfers are money flowing out of the United States in the form of, for example, military aid, foreign aid, and global charities. Because the money leaves the country, enter it under Imports and in the final column as well, as a negative.

p87.original: Step 6. Calculate the trade balance by subtracting imports from exports in both goods and services. Enter this in the final Balance column. This can be positive or negative.

p206.original: Trade Balances and Flows of Financial Capital
p206.zh: 金融资本的贸易平衡和流动

p207.original: As economists see it, trade surpluses can be either good or bad, depending on circumstances, and trade deficits can be good or bad, too. The challenge is to understand how the international flows of goods and services are connected with international flows of financial capital. In this module we will illustrate the intimate connection between trade balances and flows of financial capital in two ways: a parable of trade between Robinson Crusoe and Friday, and a circular flow diagram representing flows of trade and payments.
p207.zh: 正如经济学家所见,贸易顺差可能好或坏,视具体情况而定,贸易逆差也可能好或坏.面临的挑战是了解货物和服务的国际流动如何与国际金融资本流动相联系。 在本单元中,我们将以两种方式说明贸易平衡和金融资本流动之间的密切联系:罗宾逊·克鲁索和星期五之间的贸易实例,以及反映贸易和支付流动的循环流动图。

p208.original: A Two-Person Economy: Robinson Crusoe and Friday
p208.zh: 双人经济:罗宾逊·克鲁索和星期五

p209.original: To understand how economists view trade deficits and surpluses, consider a parable based on the story of Robinson Crusoe. Crusoe, as you may remember from the classic novel by Daniel Defoe first published in 1719, was shipwrecked on a desert island. After living alone for some time, he is joined by a second person, whom he names Friday. Think about the balance of trade in a two-person economy like that of Robinson and Friday.
p209.zh: 为了了解经济学家如何看待贸易赤字和盈余,考虑一个基于罗宾逊·克鲁索的故事的比喻.克鲁索从丹尼尔·德福(Daniel Defoe)于1719年首次出版的经典小说中可能记得,在荒岛上沉没了. 在独居一段时间后,他与第二个人会合,他给星期五取名。想想像罗宾逊和周五那样的两个人经济中贸易的平衡.

p210.original: Robinson and Friday trade goods and services. Perhaps Robinson catches fish and trades them to Friday for coconuts, or Friday weaves a hat out of tree fronds and trades it to Robinson for help in carrying water. For a period of time, each individual trade is self-contained and complete. Because each trade is voluntary, both Robinson and Friday must feel that they are receiving fair value for what they are giving. As a result, each person’s exports are always equal to his imports, and trade is always in balance between the two. Neither person experiences either a trade deficit or a trade surplus.
p210.zh: Robinson和星期五进行货物和服务贸易。 也许罗宾逊钓鱼然后交易到周五买椰子 或者周五用树叶织一顶帽子 然后用它换到罗宾逊 来帮助运水 在一段时间内,每个个体贸易都是自成一体和完整的. 由于每项交易都是自愿的,罗宾逊和星期五都必须感到它们正在获得它们所给予物品的公允价值。 因此,每个人的出口总是与他的进口相等,贸易总是在两者之间保持平衡。无论是贸易逆差还是贸易顺差,都不存在。

p211.original: However, one day Robinson approaches Friday with a proposition. Robinson wants to dig ditches for an irrigation system for his garden, but he knows that if he starts this project, he will not have much time left to fish and gather coconuts to feed himself each day. He proposes that Friday supply him with a certain number of fish and coconuts for several months, and then after that time, he promises to repay Friday out of the extra produce that he will be able to grow in his irrigated garden. If Friday accepts this offer, then a trade imbalance comes into being. For several months, Friday will have a trade surplus: that is, he is exporting to Robinson more than he is importing. More precisely, he is giving Robinson fish and coconuts, and at least for the moment, he is receiving nothing in return. Conversely, Robinson will have a trade deficit, because he is importing more from Friday than he is exporting.
p211.zh: 但是,有一天,罗宾逊 接近星期五有一个提议。Robinson想为他的花园挖沟渠,为灌溉系统,但他知道,如果他开始这个项目,他将没有太多时间去捕鱼,每天收集椰子来养活自己. 他提议周五给他提供一定数量的鱼和椰子数月,之后他承诺从额外的产品中偿还周五,使他能在灌溉的花园里种植. 如果星期五接受这一提议,贸易不平衡就会出现。几个月来,星期五将出现贸易顺差:也就是说,他向罗宾逊的出口比进口多。更确切地说,他正在给罗宾逊鱼和椰子,至少目前他没有得到任何回报。 相反,罗宾逊将出现贸易逆差,因为他从星期五开始的进口比出口多。

p212.original: This parable raises several useful issues in thinking about what a trade deficit and a trade surplus really mean in economic terms. The first issue that this story of Robinson and Friday raises is this: Is it better to have a trade surplus or a trade deficit? The answer, as in any voluntary market interaction, is that if both parties agree to the transaction, then they may both be better off. Over time, if Robinson’s irrigated garden is a success, it is certainly possible that both Robinson and Friday can benefit from this agreement.
p212.zh: 这一比喻在思考贸易赤字和贸易顺差在经济方面的真正含义时提出了几个有用的问题。罗宾逊和周五的故事提出的第一个问题是:贸易顺差还是贸易逆差更好?与任何自愿市场互动一样,答案是,如果双方同意交易,那么双方都会更好。 如果Robinson的灌溉花园成功,

p213.original: The parable raises a second issue: What can go wrong? Robinson’s proposal to Friday introduces an element of uncertainty. Friday is, in effect, making a loan of fish and coconuts to Robinson, and Friday’s happiness with this arrangement will depend on whether Robinson repays that loan as planned, in full and on time. Perhaps Robinson spends several months loafing and never builds the irrigation system, or perhaps Robinson has been too optimistic about how much he will be able to grow with the new irrigation system, which turns out not to be very productive. Perhaps, after building the irrigation system, Robinson decides that he does not want to repay Friday as much as he previously agreed. Any of these developments will prompt a new round of negotiations between Friday and Robinson. Why the repayment failed is likely to shape Friday’s attitude toward these renegotiations. If Robinson worked very hard and the irrigation system just did not increase production as intended, Friday may have some sympathy. If Robinson loafed or if he just refuses to pay, Friday may become irritated.
p213.zh: 譬喻提出第二个问题:会出什么问题?Robinson提议周五讨论一个不确定因素。周五实际上是向罗宾逊提供鱼和椰子的贷款,周五对这一安排的满意程度将取决于罗宾逊是否如期全额和按时偿还了这笔贷款。 也许罗宾逊花了几个月的时间闲逛,从未建造过灌溉系统,或者也许罗宾逊对随着新的灌溉系统而能够成长的幅度过于乐观,结果发现这种灌溉系统没有很大的生产力. 也许,在修建灌溉系统之后,罗宾逊决定他不想像以前同意的那样偿还星期五的费用。任何这些事态发展都将促使在星期五和罗宾逊之间进行新一轮谈判。为何偿还失败, 很可能会影响星期五对这些重新谈判的态度。 如果罗宾逊非常努力工作,灌溉系统只是没有按照预期增加产量,星期五可能会有一些同情心. 如果罗宾逊脱口而出,或者他只是拒绝支付,星期五可能会变得烦恼.

p214.original: A third issue that the parable raises is that an intimate relationship exists between a trade deficit and international borrowing, and between a trade surplus and international lending. The size of Friday’s trade surplus is exactly how much he is lending to Robinson. The size of Robinson’s trade deficit is exactly how much he is borrowing from Friday. To economists, a trade surplus literally means the same thing as an outflow of financial capital, and a trade deficit literally means the same thing as an inflow of financial capital. This last insight is worth exploring in greater detail, which we will do in the following section.
p214.zh: 举例来说,提出的第三个问题是,贸易逆差与国际借贷之间存在密切关系,贸易顺差与国际贷款之间存在密切关系。周五的贸易顺差数额正好是他向鲁滨逊贷款的数额。Robinson的贸易逆差数额正好是他从星期五借来的。 对经济学家来说,贸易盈余在字面上与金融资本的流出具有同等意义,而贸易赤字在字面上与金融资本的流入具有同等意义. 最后一点的见解值得更详细地探讨,我们将在下一节中进行探讨。

p215.zh: Robinson和Friday的故事也提供了一个很好的机会来考虑比较优势法则,你在国际贸易一章中对此有了更多的了解。 以下的Work It Out 介绍你们通过计算1800年代美国和英国之间交易的小麦和布料的比较优势的阶梯。

p217.original: In the 1800s, the United States and Britain traded wheat and cloth.  shows the varying hours of labor per unit of output.
p217.zh: 在1800年代,美国和英国交易小麦和布匹. 显示了每单位产出的劳动时数不同.

p221.zh: 小麦的相对劳动力成本(Pw/Pc)

p233.original: Step 1. Observe from  that, in the United States, it takes eight hours to supply a bushel of wheat and nine hours to supply a yard of cloth. In contrast, it takes four hours to supply a bushel of wheat and three hours to supply a yard of cloth in Britain.
p233.zh: 步骤1。 从中观察,在美国,供应一整匹小麦需要8小时,供应一院布料需要9小时.相比之下,在英国,提供一匹小麦的灌木丛需要四个小时,提供一院布料需要三个小时.

p234.original: Step 2. Recognize the difference between absolute advantage and comparative advantage. Britain has an absolute advantage (lowest cost) in each good, since it takes a lower amount of labor to make each good in Britain. Britain also has a comparative advantage in the production of cloth (lower opportunity cost in cloth (3/4 versus 9/8)). The United States has a comparative advantage in wheat production (lower opportunity cost of 8/9 versus 4/3).
p234.zh: 步骤二.承认绝对优势与比较优势之间的区别.英国在每一件好事上都具有绝对优势(成本最低),因为使每件好事在英国都需花费更低的劳动力.英国在布匹生产方面也具有比较优势(布匹的机会成本较低(3/4比9/8)). 美国在小麦生产方面具有相对优势(机会成本较低,为8/9,而4/3)。

p235.original: Step 3. Determine the relative price of one good in terms of the other good. The price of wheat, in this example, is the amount of cloth you have to give up. To find this price, convert the hours per unit of wheat and cloth into units per hour. To do so, observe that in the United States it takes eight hours to make a bushel of wheat, so workers can process 1/8 of a bushel of wheat in an hour. It takes nine hours to make a yard of cloth in the United States, so workers can produce 1/9 of a yard of cloth in an hour. If you divide the amount of cloth (1/9 of a yard) by the amount of wheat you give up (1/8 of a bushel) in an hour, you find the price (8/9) of one good (wheat) in terms of the other (cloth).
p235.zh: 步骤3。确定一品与另一品的相对价格. 小麦的价格,在这个例子中,是必须放弃的布的量. 为了找到这一价格,将每单位小麦和布料的时数转换成每小时的单位. 为此,观察一下,在美国,制作小麦灌木需要8小时,这样工人就可以在1小时之内加工1/8的小麦灌木.在美国制造一院布料需要9小时,因此工人可以在1小时内生产一院布料的1/9. 如果将布料数量(一个院子的1/9)除以一个小时内放弃的麦子数量(一个灌木的1/8),则会发现一件好(麦)的价格(8/9)与另一件好(毛)的价格(毛)相差.

p236.original: The Balance of Trade as the Balance of Payments
p236.zh: 贸易平衡作为国际收支

p237.original: The connection between trade balances and international flows of financial capital is so close that economists sometimes describe the balance of trade as the balance of payments. Each category of the current account balance involves a corresponding flow of payments between a given country and the rest of the world economy.
p237.zh: 贸易平衡与国际金融资本流动之间的联系如此密切,经济学家有时将贸易平衡描述为国际收支.经常账户余额的每一种类型都涉及某一国家与世界经济其他国家之间的相应支付流动。

p238.original: shows the flow of goods and services and payments between one country—the United States in this example—and the rest of the world. The top line shows U.S. exports of goods and services, while the second line shows financial payments from purchasers in other countries back to the U.S. economy. The third line then shows U.S. imports of goods, services, and investment, and the fourth line shows payments from the home economy to the rest of the world. Flow of goods and services (lines one and three) show up in the current account, while we find flow of funds (lines two and four) in the financial account.
p238.zh: 表明一个国家——以美国为例——与世界其他国家之间的货物和服务流动和付款。上行显示美国出口货物和服务,第二行显示其他国家购买者向美国经济支付的财政款项. 第三行随后显示美国进口商品,服务和投资,第四行显示从母国经济到世界其他地方的付款.货物和服务流动(第1行和第3行)在经常账户中出现,而我们在财务账户中发现资金流动(第2行和第4行)。

p239.original: The bottom four lines in  show the flows of investment income. In the first of the bottom lines, we see investments made abroad with funds flowing from the home country to the rest of the world. Investment income stemming from an investment abroad then runs in the other direction from the rest of the world to the home country. Similarly, we see on the bottom third line, an investment from the rest of the world into the home country and investment income (bottom fourth line) flowing from the home country to the rest of the world. We find the investment income (bottom lines two and four) in the current account, while investment to the rest of the world or into the home country (lines one and three) is in the financial account. This figure does not show unilateral transfers, the fourth item in the current account.
p239.zh: 下四行显示投资收入的流量。 在第一线,我们看到海外投资,资金从母国流向世界其他地区。海外投资产生的投资收入从世界其他地方流向母国。 同样,我们从第3行看,世界其他地方对母国的投资,以及从母国流向世界其他地区的投资收入(第4行)。 我们发现经常账户中的投资收入(下行2和4),而向世界其他地区或母国的投资(一行和三行)则在财务账户中。这一数字没有显示单边转账,这是经常账户中的第四个项目。

p240.original: Flow of Investment Goods and Capital

p241.original: A current account deficit means that, the country is a net borrower from abroad. Conversely, a positive current account balance means a country is a net lender to the rest of the world. Just like the parable of Robinson and Friday, the lesson is that a trade surplus means an overall outflow of financial investment capital, as domestic investors put their funds abroad, while a deficit in the current account balance is exactly equal to the overall or net inflow of foreign investment capital from abroad.
p241.zh: 经常账户赤字意味着,该国是国外的净借款国。 相反,经常账户的正结余意味着一个国家是向世界其他地方提供贷款的净贷方。与罗宾逊和星期五的比喻一样,教训是,贸易盈余意味着金融投资资本的总流出,因为国内投资者将其资金放在国外,而经常账户余额的赤字正好等于外国投资资本从国外总流入或净流入。

p242.original: It is important to recognize that an inflow and outflow of foreign capital does not necessarily refer to a debt that governments owe to other governments, although government debt may be part of the picture. Instead, these international flows of financial capital refer to all of the ways in which private investors in one country may invest in another country—by buying real estate, companies, and financial investments like stocks and bonds.
p242.zh: 必须认识到,外国资本的流入和流出并不一定是指政府欠其他政府的债务,尽管政府债务可能是其中的一部分。 相反,这些国际资金流动指的是一国私人投资者在另一国投资的所有方式,例如购买房地产、公司和股票和债券等金融投资。

p244.original: International flows of goods and services are closely connected to the international flows of financial capital. A current account deficit means that, after taking all the flows of payments from goods, services, and income together, the country is a net borrower from the rest of the world. A current account surplus is the opposite and means the country is a net lender to the rest of the world.
p244.zh: 货物和服务的国际流动与金融资本的国际流动密切相关。经常账户赤字意味着,在将货物、服务和收入的所有支付流动合并起来之后,该国是世界其他地方的净借款国。经常账户盈余正好相反,意味着该国是向世界其他地区提供净贷款的国家。

p246.original:
State whether each of the following events involves a financial flow to the U.S. economy or away from the U.S. economy:
Export sales to Germany
Returns paid on past U.S. financial investments in Brazil
Foreign aid from the U.S. government to Egypt
Imported oil from the Russian Federation
Japanese investors buying U.S. real estate
p246.zh: 说明以下事件是否都涉及流向美国经济或远离美国经济的资金流动: 出口对德国的销售 回归美国过去在巴西的金融投资 美国政府对埃及的外援 进口来自俄罗斯联邦的石油 购买美国房地产的日本投资者

p247.original: An export sale to Germany involves a financial flow from Germany to the U.S. economy.
p247.zh: 对德国的出口销售涉及从德国流向美国经济的资金流动.

p248.original: The issue here is not U.S. investments in Brazil, but the return paid on those investments, which involves a financial flow from the Brazilian economy to the U.S. economy.
p248.zh: 这里的问题不是美国对巴西的投资,而是这些投资的回报,这涉及到巴西经济向美国经济的资金流动.

p249.original: Foreign aid from the United States to Egypt is a financial flow from the United States to Egypt.
p249.zh: 美国对埃及的外援是美国对埃及的资金流动.

p250.original: Importing oil from the Russian Federation means a flow of financial payments from the U.S. economy to the Russian Federation.
p250.zh: 从俄罗斯联邦进口石油,是指从美国经济向俄罗斯联邦的金融支付流动.

p251.original: Japanese investors buying U.S. real estate is a financial flow from Japan to the U.S. economy.
p251.zh: 日本投资者购买美国房地产是日本向美国经济的资金流动.

p252.original: How does the bottom portion of , showing the international flow of investments and capital, differ from the upper portion?
p252.zh: 显示投资和资本的国际流动的下半部分与上半部分有何不同?

p253.original: The top portion tracks the flow of exports and imports and the payments for those. The bottom portion is looking at international financial investments and the outflow and inflow of monies from those investments. These investments can include investments in stocks and bonds or real estate abroad, as well as international borrowing and lending.
p253.zh: 最高部分跟踪进出口的流量和付款情况。 最底层部分是国际金融投资以及这些投资的资金流出和流入。 这些投资可包括对股票和债券或国外房地产的投资,以及国际借贷。

p254.original: Explain the relationship between a current account deficit or surplus and the flow of funds.
p254.zh: 解释经常账户赤字或盈余与资金流动之间的关系。

p255.original: If more monies are flowing out of the country (for example, to pay for imports) it will make the current account more negative or less positive, and if more monies are flowing into the country, it will make the current account less negative or more positive.
p255.zh: 如果更多资金流出该国(例如,支付进口品),它将使经常账户更负或更负,如果更多资金流入该国,它将使经常账户更负或更正面。

p257.original: Does a trade surplus mean an overall inflow of financial capital to an economy, or an overall outflow of financial capital? What about a trade deficit?
p257.zh: 贸易顺差是指金融资本向某一经济体的总体流入,还是金融资本的总体流出?贸易逆差呢?

p259.original: Is it better for your country to be an international lender or borrower?
p259.zh: 贵国成为国际贷款人或借款人是否更好?

p260.original: The National Saving and Investment Identity

p261.original: The close connection between trade balances and international flows of savings and investments leads to a macroeconomic analysis. This approach views trade balances—and their associated flows of financial capital—in the context of the overall levels of savings and financial investment in the economy.
p261.zh: 贸易平衡与国际储蓄和投资流动之间的密切联系导致宏观经济分析。这种办法从储蓄和金融投资对经济的总体水平来看贸易平衡及其相关的金融资本流动。

p262.original: Understanding the Determinants of the Trade and Current Account Balance
p262.zh: 理解贸易和经常账户余额的决定因素

p263.original: The national saving and investment identity provides a useful way to understand the determinants of the trade and current account balance. In a nation’s financial capital market, the quantity of financial capital supplied at any given time must equal the quantity of financial capital demanded for purposes of making investments. What is on the supply and demand sides of financial capital? See the following Clear It Up feature for the answer to this question.
p263.zh: 国家储蓄和投资特征为了解贸易和经常账户平衡的决定因素提供了有用的途径。 在一个国家的金融资本市场上,任何特定时间提供的金融资本数量必须等同于为投资目的所需的金融资本数量。金融资本的供应和需求方面是什么?这个问题的答案见以下Clear It Up特征。

p264.original: What comprises the supply and demand of financial capital?
p264.zh: 金融资本的供应和需求是什么?

p265.original: A country’s national savings is the total of its domestic savings by household and companies (private savings) as well as the government (public savings). If a country is running a trade deficit, it means money from abroad is entering the country and the government considers it part of the supply of financial capital.
p265.zh: 一个国家的国民储蓄是家庭和公司(私人储蓄)以及政府(公共储蓄)的国内储蓄总额。 如果一个国家出现贸易逆差,则意味着来自国外的货币正在进入该国,政府认为这是金融资本供应的一部分.

p266.original: The demand for financial capital (money) represents groups that are borrowing the money. Businesses need to borrow to finance their investments in factories, materials, and personnel. When the federal government runs a budget deficit, it is also borrowing money from investors by selling Treasury bonds. Therefore, both business investment and the federal government can demand (or borrow) the supply of savings.
p266.zh: 对金融资本(资金)的需求代表着借钱的集团.企业需要借钱来资助其在工厂,材料,和人员方面的投资. 当联邦政府出现预算赤字时,它也是通过出售国库债券向投资者借钱. 因此,商业投资和联邦政府都可以要求(或借)储蓄的供应.

p267.original: There are two main sources for the supply of financial capital in the U.S. economy: saving by individuals and firms, called S, and the inflow of financial capital from foreign investors, which is equal to the trade deficit (M – X), or imports minus exports. There are also two main sources of demand for financial capital in the U.S. economy: private sector investment, I, and government borrowing, where the government needs to borrow when government spending, G, is higher than the taxes collected, T. We can express this national savings and investment identity in algebraic terms:
p267.zh: 美国经济中金融资本供应有两个主要来源:个人和公司储蓄,称为S,以及外国投资者流入的金融资本,相当于贸易逆差(M – X)或进口减出口. 美国经济对金融资本的需求也有两个主要来源: 民营部门投资一,政府借款,当政府支出高于所征收的税收时,政府需要借入,G. 我们可以用代数来表达这种国民储蓄和投资特性:

p268.original: Again, in this equation, S is private savings, T is taxes, G is government spending, M is imports, X is exports, and I is investment. This relationship is true as a matter of definition because, for the macro economy, the quantity supplied of financial capital must be equal to the quantity demanded.
p268.zh: 同样,在这个公式中,S是私人储蓄,T是税收,G是政府支出,M是进口,X是出口,我是投资.这种关系在定义上是真实的,因为对于宏观经济来说,所供应的金融资本的数量必须等于所要求的数量。

p269.original: However, certain components of the national savings and investment identity can switch between the supply side and the demand side. Some countries, like the United States in most years since the 1970s, have budget deficits, which mean the government is spending more than it collects in taxes, and so the government needs to borrow funds. In this case, the government term would be G – T > 0, showing that spending is larger than taxes, and the government would be a demander of financial capital on the right-hand side of the equation (that is, a borrower), not a supplier of financial capital on the left-hand side. However, if the government runs a budget surplus so that the taxes exceed spending, as the U.S. government did from 1998 to 2001, then the government in that year was contributing to the supply of financial capital (T – G > 0), and would appear on the left (supplier or saving) side of the national savings and investment identity.
p269.zh: 但是,国民储蓄和投资身份的某些组成部分可以在供应方和需求方之间发生转变。 一些国家,如美国自1970年代以来的多数年头,都存在预算赤字,这意味着政府开支超过税收,因此政府需要借钱. 在这种情况下,政府术语将是G – T > 0,表明支出大于税收,政府将是等式右侧的金融资本需求者(即借款人),而不是左侧的金融资本供给者. 然而,如果政府有预算盈余,以致税收超过支出,正如美国政府在1998年至2001年所做的那样,那么当年的政府正在为金融资本(T-G > 0)的供应做出贡献,并将出现在国民储蓄和投资身份的左侧(供货人或储蓄人).

p270.original: Similarly, if a national economy runs a trade surplus, the trade sector will involve an outflow of financial capital to other countries. A trade surplus means that the domestic financial capital is in surplus within a country and can be invested in other countries.
p270.zh: 同样,如果国家经济出现贸易顺差,贸易部门将涉及金融资本向其他国家流出。贸易顺差是指国内金融资本在一国内部出现顺差,可以投资到其他国家.

p271.original: The fundamental notion that total quantity of financial capital demanded equals total quantity of financial capital supplied must always remain true. Domestic savings will always appear as part of the supply of financial capital and domestic investment will always appear as part of the demand for financial capital. However, the government and trade balance elements of the equation can move back and forth as either suppliers or demanders of financial capital, depending on whether government budgets and the trade balance are in surplus or deficit.
p271.zh: 金融资本需求总量等于所供应金融资本总量这一基本概念必须始终如一。国内储蓄将始终作为金融资本供应的一部分出现,国内投资将始终作为金融资本需求的一部分出现。 然而,政府和贸易平衡因素可以前后移动,要么作为金融资本的提供者,要么作为需求者,这取决于政府预算和贸易平衡是否出现盈余或赤字。

p272.original: Domestic Saving and Investment Determine the Trade Balance
p272.zh: 国内储蓄和投资决定贸易平衡

p273.original: One insight from the national saving and investment identity is that a nation's own levels of domestic saving and investment determine a nation’s balance of trade. To understand this point, rearrange the identity to put the balance of trade all by itself on one side of the equation. Consider first the situation with a trade deficit, and then the situation with a trade surplus.
p273.zh: 从国家储蓄和投资特征中得出的一个见解是,一个国家自己的国内储蓄和投资水平决定着一个国家的贸易平衡。 为了理解这一点,重新整理身份,将贸易平衡单独放在方程式的一边。 首先考虑贸易逆差的情况,然后考虑贸易顺差的情况。

p274.original:
In the case of a trade deficit, the national saving and investment identity can be rewritten as:


Trade deficit = Domestic investment – Private domestic saving – Government (or public) savings(M – X) = I – S – (T – G)
p274.zh: 在贸易逆差的情况下,国民储蓄和投资身份可以重写为: 贸易逆差=国内投资 私人国内储蓄 公共(或公共)储蓄(M-X)=I-S(T-G)

p275.original: In this case, domestic investment is higher than domestic saving, including both private and government saving. The only way that domestic investment can exceed domestic saving is if capital is flowing into a country from abroad. After all, that extra financial capital for investment has to come from someplace.
p275.zh: 在这种情况下,国内投资高于国内储蓄,包括私人和政府的储蓄。国内投资能够超过国内储蓄的唯一办法是资本从国外流入一个国家。毕竟,额外的金融资本 投资必须来自某个地方。

p276.original:
Now consider a trade surplus from the standpoint of the national saving and investment identity:


Trade surplus = Private domestic saving + Public saving – Domestic investment(X – M) = S + (T – G) – I
p276.zh: 现在从国民储蓄和投资特征的角度考虑贸易盈余:贸易盈余=私人国内储蓄+公共储蓄 – 国内投资(X–M)=S+(T–G)–I

p277.original: In this case, domestic savings (both private and public) is higher than domestic investment. That extra financial capital will be invested abroad.
p277.zh: 在这种情况下,国内储蓄(包括私人和公共储蓄)高于国内投资。这笔额外的金融资本将投入国外。

p278.original: This connection of domestic saving and investment to the trade balance explains why economists view the balance of trade as a fundamentally macroeconomic phenomenon. As the national saving and investment identity shows, the performance of certain sectors of an economy, like cars or steel, do not determine the trade balance. Further, whether the nation’s trade laws and regulations encourage free trade or protectionism also does not determine the trade balance (see Globalization and Protectionism).
p278.zh: 国内储蓄和投资与贸易平衡的这种联系解释了为什么经济学家将贸易平衡视为一个基本的宏观经济现象。 正如国家储蓄和投资特征所示,一个经济体的某些部门,如汽车或钢铁,其业绩不能决定贸易平衡。 此外,国家的贸易法律和条例是否鼓励自由贸易或保护主义,也不决定贸易的平衡(见全球化和保护主义)。

p279.original: Exploring Trade Balances One Factor at a Time
p279.zh: 一次探索贸易平衡的一个因素

p280.original:
The national saving and investment identity also provides a framework for thinking about what will cause trade deficits to rise or fall. Begin with the version of the identity that has domestic savings and investment on the left and the trade deficit on the right:
Domestic investment – Private domestic savings – Public domestic savings = Trade deficitI – S – (T – G) = (M – X)
p280.zh: 国家储蓄和投资特性也为思考什么会导致贸易赤字上升或下降提供了一个框架。首先是左侧有国内储蓄和投资,右侧有贸易逆差的特征: 国内投资 — 私人国内储蓄 — 公共国内储蓄 — 贸易逆差I — S — (T– G) = (M– X)

p281.original: Now, consider the factors on the left-hand side of the equation one at a time, while holding the other factors constant.
p281.zh: 现在,一次考虑方程式左侧的因子,同时保持其他因素不变.

p282.original: As a first example, assume that the level of domestic investment in a country rises, while the level of private and public saving remains unchanged.  shows the result in the first row under the equation. Since the equality of the national savings and investment identity must continue to hold—it is, after all, an identity that must be true by definition—the rise in domestic investment will mean a higher trade deficit. This situation occurred in the U.S. economy in the late 1990s. Because of the surge of new information and communications technologies that became available, business investment increased substantially. A fall in private saving during this time and a rise in government saving more or less offset each other. As a result, the financial capital to fund that business investment came from abroad, which is one reason for the very high U.S. trade deficits of the late 1990s and early 2000s.
p282.zh: 首先,假设一国的国内投资水平上升,而私人和公共储蓄水平保持不变。 由于国家储蓄和投资身份的平等必须继续存在——毕竟,这种身份从定义上讲必须是真实的——国内投资的增加意味着贸易赤字增加。 这种情况发生在1990年代后期的美国经济中. 由于获得的新的信息和通信技术激增,商业投资大幅增加。在此期间私人储蓄减少,政府储蓄增加,两者或多或少相互抵消. 因此,为商业投资提供资金的金融资本来自国外,这是美国1990年代末和2000年代初贸易赤字非常高的原因之一。

p283.original: Causes of a Changing Trade Balance

p319.original: As a second scenario, assume that the level of domestic savings rises, while the level of domestic investment and public savings remain unchanged. In this case, the trade deficit would decline. As domestic savings rises, there would be less need for foreign financial capital to meet investment needs. For this reason, a policy proposal often made for reducing the U.S. trade deficit is to increase private saving—although exactly how to increase the overall rate of saving has proven controversial.
p319.zh: 第二种假设是,国内储蓄水平上升,而国内投资和公共储蓄水平保持不变。 在这种情况下,贸易赤字将下降。 随着国内储蓄的上升,对外国金融资本满足投资需要的需求将减少。 因此,经常提出的减少美国贸易赤字的政策建议是增加私人储蓄——尽管事实证明,究竟如何提高总储蓄率是有争议的。

p320.original: As a third scenario, imagine that the government budget deficit increased dramatically, while domestic investment and private savings remained unchanged. This scenario occurred in the U.S. economy in the mid-1980s. The federal budget deficit increased from $79 billion in 1981 to $221 billion in 1986—an increase in the demand for financial capital of $142 billion. The current account balance collapsed from a surplus of $5 billion in 1981 to a deficit of $147 billion in 1986—an increase in the supply of financial capital from abroad of $152 billion. The connection at that time is clear: a sharp increase in government borrowing increased the U.S. economy’s demand for financial capital, and foreign investors through the trade deficit primarily supplied that increase. The following Work It Out feature walks you through a scenario in which private domestic savings has to rise by a certain amount to reduce a trade deficit.
p320.zh: 第三种情况是,设想政府预算赤字急剧增加,而国内投资和私人储蓄则保持不变。1980年代中期,美国经济出现了这种情况。联邦预算赤字从1981年的790亿美元增加到1986年的2210亿美元——对金融资本的需求增加了1 420亿美元。经常账户余额从1981年的50亿美元盈余下降到1986年的1 470亿美元赤字——国外金融资本供应增加1 520亿美元。 当时的联系是明确的:政府借贷的急剧增加增加了美国对金融资本的需求,外国投资者通过贸易赤字主要提供这种增长。接下来的“工作”节目 将你带入一个 私人国内储蓄必须增加一定数额 才能减少贸易赤字的情景。

p321.original: Solving Problems with the Saving and Investment Identity
p321.zh: 解决储蓄和投资身份问题

To reduce the $200 billion trade deficit by $100 billion, by how much does private domestic savings have to increase?

p331.original: Short-Term Movements in the Business Cycle and the Trade Balance
p331.zh: 商业周期和贸易平衡的短期流动

p332.original: In the short run, whether an economy is in a recession or on the upswing can affect trade imbalances. A recession tends to make a trade deficit smaller, or a trade surplus larger, while a period of strong economic growth tends to make a trade deficit larger, or a trade surplus smaller. These are not hard-and-fast rules, however.
p332.zh: 从短期来看,经济是否处于衰退状态或正在上升,都可能影响贸易不平衡。经济衰退往往使贸易赤字减少,或贸易顺差增加,而强劲经济增长的时期往往使贸易逆差增加,或贸易顺差减少。 然而,这些并不是硬的和快速的规则。

p333.original: As an example, note in  that the U.S. trade deficit declined by almost half from 2006 to 2009. One primary reason for this change is that during the recession, as the U.S. economy slowed down, it purchased fewer of all goods, including fewer imports from abroad. However, buying power abroad fell less, and so U.S. exports did not fall by as much. On the other hand, during the 2020 pandemic-induced recession, the trade deficit expanded (current account balance plummeted) as the U.S. economy became more reliant on other countries for goods and services.
p333.zh: 例如,2006年至2009年,美国贸易逆差几乎减少了一半。造成这一变化的一个主要原因是,在经济衰退期间,随着美国经济放缓,它购买的所有商品都较少,包括从国外进口的商品也较少. 然而,国外购买力下降较少,因此美国出口并没有减少。 另一方面,在2020年大流行病引发的衰退期间,随着美国经济更加依赖其他国家提供货物和服务,贸易赤字扩大(经常账户余额急剧下降)。

p334.original: Conversely, in the mid-2000s, when the U.S. trade deficit became very large, a contributing short-term reason is that the U.S. economy was growing. As a result, there was considerable aggressive buying in the U.S. economy, including the buying of imports. Thus, a trade deficit (or a much lower trade surplus) often accompanies a rapidly growing domestic economy, while a trade surplus (or a much lower trade deficit) accompanies a slowing or recessionary domestic economy.
p334.zh: 反之,在2000年代中期,当美国贸易赤字变得非常大的时候,一个促成的短期原因是美国经济正在增长. 因此,美国经济中出现了相当积极的购买,包括购买进口. 因此,贸易逆差(或贸易顺差低得多)往往伴随着迅速增长的国内经济,而贸易顺差(或贸易逆差低得多)则伴随着缓慢或衰退的国内经济。

p335.original: Regardless of whether the trade deficit falls or rises during expansions or downturns, when the trade deficit rises, it necessarily means a greater net inflow of foreign financial capital. The national saving and investment identity teaches that the rest of the economy can absorb this inflow of foreign financial capital in several different ways. For example, reduced private savings could offset the additional inflow of financial capital from abroad, leaving domestic investment and public saving unchanged. Alternatively, the inflow of foreign financial capital could result in higher domestic investment, leaving private and public saving unchanged. Yet another possibility is that greater government borrowing could absorb the inflow of foreign financial capital, leaving domestic saving and investment unchanged. The national saving and investment identity does not specify which of these scenarios, alone or in combination, will occur—only that one of them must occur.
p335.zh: 无论贸易逆差在扩张或下滑期间是下降还是上升,当贸易逆差上升时,都必然意味着外国金融资本的净流入量增加。国民储蓄和投资特征表明,经济的其余部分能够以几种不同方式吸收外国金融资本的流入。 例如,减少私人储蓄可以抵消国外金融资本的额外流入,使国内投资和公共储蓄保持不变。 或者,外国金融资本的流入可能导致国内投资增加,使私人和公共储蓄保持不变。另一种可能性是,更多的政府借款可以吸收外国金融资本的流入,使国内储蓄和投资保持不变。国家储蓄和投资特性没有具体说明这些假设中有哪些单独或组合发生,只有其中一种必须发生。

p337.original:
The national saving and investment identity is based on the relationship that the total quantity of financial capital supplied from all sources must equal the total quantity of financial capital demanded from all sources. If S is private saving, T is taxes, G is government spending, M is imports, X is exports, and I is investment, then for an economy with a current account deficit and a budget deficit:

Supply of financial capital = Demand for financial capitalS +  (M – X)=I +  (G – T) 




A recession tends to increase the trade balance (meaning a higher trade surplus or lower trade deficit), while economic boom will tend to decrease the trade balance (meaning a lower trade surplus or a larger trade deficit).
p337.zh: 国家储蓄和投资特征基于一种关系,即所有来源提供的金融资本总量必须等于所有来源要求的金融资本总量。 如果S是私人储蓄,T是税收,G是政府支出,M是进口,X是出口,我则是投资,那么对于一个经常账户赤字和预算赤字的经济体来说: 金融资本供应=对金融资本的需求+(M-X)=I+(G-T) 经济衰退倾向于增加贸易平衡(意味着贸易顺差或贸易逆差降低),而经济繁荣则倾向于减少贸易平衡(意味着贸易顺差减少或贸易逆差增加).

p339.original:
Using the national savings and investment identity, explain how each of the following changes (ceteris paribus) will increase or decrease the trade balance:

A lower domestic savings rate
The government changes from running a budget surplus to running a budget deficit
The rate of domestic investment surges
p339.zh: 利用国民储蓄和投资特性,解释以下每个变化(cesteris paribus)将如何增加或减少贸易平衡: 国内储蓄率降低 政府从预算盈余变为预算赤字 国内投资率激增

p340.original:
Write out the national savings and investment identity for the situation of the economy implied by this question:

Supply of capital = Demand for capitalS +  (M – X) + (T – G) = I Savings +  (trade deficit) +  (government budget surplus)=Investment




If domestic savings increases and nothing else changes, then the trade deficit will fall. In effect, the economy would be relying more on domestic capital and less on foreign capital. If the government starts borrowing instead of saving, then the trade deficit must rise. In effect, the government is no longer providing savings and so, if nothing else is to change, more investment funds must arrive from abroad. If the rate of domestic investment surges, then, ceteris paribus, the trade deficit must also rise, to provide the extra capital. The ceteris paribus—or “other things being equal”—assumption is important here. In all of these situations, there is no reason to expect in the real world that the original change will affect only, or primarily, the trade deficit. The identity only says that something will adjust—it does not specify what.
p340.zh: 写出这个问题所隐含的经济形势的国民储蓄和投资身份: 资本供应=资本需求+(M-X)+(T-G)=一储蓄+(贸易赤字)+(政府预算盈余)=投资 如果国内储蓄增加,其他情况没有变化,那么贸易赤字就会下降. 实际上,经济将更多地依赖国内资本,而较少依赖外国资本。 如果政府开始借款而不是储蓄,那么贸易赤字就必须上升. 实际上,政府不再提供储蓄,因此,如果别无他法,就必须从国外获得更多的投资资金。 如果国内投资率猛增,那么,Ceteris paribus,贸易赤字也必须上升,以提供额外资本。 在此, " 平等 " 或 " 其他事物平等 " 的假设十分重要。在所有这些情况中,在现实世界中没有理由期望最初的变化将仅影响或主要影响贸易赤字。身份上只写着某种东西会调整,

p362.original: The Pros and Cons of Trade Deficits and Surpluses
p362.zh: 贸易赤字和盈余的利弊

p363.original: Because flows of trade always involve flows of financial payments, flows of international trade are actually the same as flows of international financial capital. The question of whether trade deficits or surpluses are good or bad for an economy is, in economic terms, exactly the same question as whether it is a good idea for an economy to rely on net inflows of financial capital from abroad or to make net investments of financial capital abroad. Conventional wisdom often holds that borrowing money is foolhardy, and that a prudent country, like a prudent person, should always rely on its own resources. While it is certainly possible to borrow too much—as anyone with an overloaded credit card can testify—borrowing at certain times can also make sound economic sense. For both individuals and countries, there is no economic merit in a policy of abstaining from participation in financial capital markets.
p363.zh: 由于贸易流动总是涉及金融支付流动,国际贸易流动实际上与国际金融资本流动相同。贸易逆差或盈余对于一个经济体是好是坏的问题,就经济而言,与一个经济体依赖国外金融资本净流入还是在国外金融资本净投资,是完全相同的问题.传统的智慧往往认为,借钱是愚蠢的,一个谨慎的国家,像谨慎的人一样,应当始终依赖自己的资源。 虽然借太多钱当然是可能的——任何信用卡超载者都可以证明这一点——但在某些时候借钱也具有合理的经济意义。 对于个人和国家来说,不参与金融资本市场的政策没有任何经济价值。

p364.original: It makes economic sense to borrow when you are buying something with a long-run payoff; that is, when you are making an investment. For this reason, it can make economic sense to borrow for a college education, because the education will typically allow you to earn higher wages, and so to repay the loan and still come out ahead. It can also make sense for a business to borrow in order to purchase a machine that will last 10 years, as long as the machine will increase output and profits by more than enough to repay the loan. Similarly, it can make economic sense for a national economy to borrow from abroad, as long as it wisely invests the money in ways that will tend to raise the nation’s economic growth over time. Then, it will be possible for the national economy to repay the borrowed money over time and still end up better off than before.
p364.zh: 当你用长期收益买东西的时候,借钱是经济合情合理的;也就是说,当你投资的时候。 因此,为大学教育借钱可以经济合理,因为教育一般会允许你挣得更高的工资,因此可以偿还贷款,而且仍然可以提前出来.也可以让企业借钱购买一台持续10年的机器,只要机器能增加产出和利润超过偿还贷款的金额. 同样,国民经济从国外借钱也具有经济意义,只要它明智地投资资金的方式能够随着时间的推移提高国民的经济增长。 然后,国民经济有可能随着时间的推移偿还借款,最终仍然比以前好。

p365.original: One vivid example of a country that borrowed heavily from abroad, invested wisely, and did perfectly well is the United States during the nineteenth century. The United States ran a trade deficit in 40 of the 45 years from 1831 to 1875, which meant that it was importing capital from abroad over that time. However, that financial capital was mostly invested in projects like railroads that brought a substantial economic payoff. (See the following Clear It Up feature for more on this.)
p365.zh: 美国在十九世纪期间,是一个从国外大量借款、明智投资、表现良好的国家,一个生动的例子。 从1831年到1875年的45年中,美国有40年的贸易逆差,这意味着美国在这段时间里从国外进口资本. 然而,这种金融资本大多投资于铁路等带来大量经济回报的项目。(关于此内容,请参见以下 Clear Up 特性 。 )

p366.original: A more recent example along these lines is the experience of South Korea, which had trade deficits during much of the 1970s—and so was an importer of capital over that time. However, South Korea also had high rates of investment in physical plant and equipment, and its economy grew rapidly. From the mid-1980s into the mid-1990s, South Korea often had trade surpluses—that is, it was repaying its past borrowing by sending capital abroad.
p366.zh: 韩国在1970年代大部分时间都有贸易逆差,而当时的资本进口商也是这样。 然而,韩国对物理设备和设备的投资率也很高,其经济迅速增长。 从1980年代中期到1990年代中期,韩国经常有贸易盈余,即通过向国外提供资本来偿还过去的借款。

p367.original: In contrast, some countries have run large trade deficits, borrowed heavily in global capital markets, and ended up in all kinds of trouble. Two specific sorts of trouble are worth examining. First, a borrower nation can find itself in a bind if it does not invest the incoming funds from abroad in a way that leads to increased productivity. Several of Latin America's large economies, including Mexico and Brazil, ran large trade deficits and borrowed heavily from abroad in the 1970s, but the inflow of financial capital did not boost productivity sufficiently, which meant that these countries faced enormous troubles repaying the money borrowed when economic conditions shifted during the 1980s. Similarly, it appears that a number of African nations that borrowed foreign funds in the 1970s and 1980s did not invest in productive economic assets. As a result, several of those countries later faced large interest payments, with no economic growth to show for the borrowed funds.
p367.zh: 相比之下,一些国家贸易赤字巨大,在全球资本市场上借债严重,最终陷入各种困境。两种特定的麻烦值得研究。 第一,如果借款国不以提高生产力的方式投资从国外收到的资金,它就会陷入困境。包括墨西哥和巴西在内的拉丁美洲几个大经济体在1970年代出现巨额贸易赤字,大量向国外借款,但金融资本的流入不足以提高生产力,这意味着这些国家在1980年代经济条件发生变化时面临巨大的困难,偿还所借的钱。 同样,一些非洲国家在1970年代和1980年代借入外国资金,似乎没有投资于生产性经济资产。 因此,其中一些国家后来面临巨额利息支付,没有经济增长来显示所借资金。

p368.zh: 贸易赤字是否总是有害的?

p369.original: For most years of the nineteenth century, U.S. imports exceeded exports and the U.S. economy had a trade deficit. Yet the string of trade deficits did not hold back the economy at all. Instead, the trade deficits contributed to the strong economic growth that gave the U.S. economy the highest per capita GDP in the world by around 1900.
p369.zh: 在19世纪的大部分年头,美国进口超过出口,美国经济出现贸易逆差. 然而,一连串的贸易赤字丝毫没有阻碍经济的发展。 相反,贸易赤字促进了强劲的经济增长,使得美国经济在1900年左右成为世界人均GDP最高的国家.

p370.original: The U.S. trade deficits meant that the U.S. economy was receiving a net inflow of foreign capital from abroad. Much of that foreign capital flowed into two areas of investment—railroads and public infrastructure like roads, water systems, and schools—which were important to helping the U.S. economy grow.
p370.zh: 美国贸易逆差意味着美国经济正接受国外外国资本的净流入.外国资本大部分流入两个投资领域——铁路和公路、供水系统和学校等公共基础设施,这对帮助美国经济增长很重要。

p371.original: We should not overstate the effect of foreign investment capital on U.S. economic growth. In most years the foreign financial capital represented no more than 6–10% of the funds that the government used for overall physical investment in the economy. Nonetheless, the trade deficit and the accompanying investment funds from abroad were clearly a help, not a hindrance, to the U.S. economy in the nineteenth century.
p371.zh: 我们不应过分强调外国投资资本对美国经济增长的影响。 在大多数年份中,外国金融资本只占政府用于经济整体实际投资的资金的6-10%。 尽管如此,贸易逆差和国外附带的投资基金显然对十九世纪的美国经济是一种帮助,而不是障碍。

p372.original: A second “trouble” is: What happens if the foreign money flows in, and then suddenly flows out again? We raised this scenario at the start of the chapter. In the mid-1990s, a number of countries in East Asia—Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, and South Korea—ran large trade deficits and imported capital from abroad. However, in 1997 and 1998 many foreign investors became concerned about the health of these economies, and quickly pulled their money out of stock and bond markets, real estate, and banks. The extremely rapid departure of that foreign capital staggered the banking systems and economies of these countries, plunging them into deep recession. We investigate and discuss the links between international capital flows, banks, and recession in The Impacts of Government Borrowing.
p372.zh: 第二个“麻烦”是:如果外国货币流入,然后突然再次流出,会怎样? 我们在本章开头提出了这一设想。 在1990年代中期,东亚的一些国家——泰国、印度尼西亚、马来西亚和韩国——出现了巨大的贸易赤字和从国外进口资本。 然而,在1997年和1998年,许多外国投资者开始对这些经济体的健康感到关切,并迅速将其资金从股票和债券市场、房地产和银行中抽出。外国资本极快的离开使这些国家的银行系统和经济错开,使它们陷入深度衰退。 我们调查并讨论国际资本流动、银行和《政府借款的影响》中的衰退之间的联系。

p373.original: While a trade deficit is not always harmful, there is no guarantee that running a trade surplus will bring robust economic health. For example, Germany and Japan ran substantial trade surpluses for most of the last three decades. Regardless of their persistent trade surpluses, both countries have experienced occasional recessions and neither country has had especially robust annual growth in recent years. Read more about Japan’s trade surplus in the next Clear It Up feature.
p373.zh: 虽然贸易逆差并不总是有害的,但无法保证贸易顺差将带来强劲的经济健康。 例如,德国和日本在过去30年的大部分时间里都有大量的贸易盈余。 尽管两国的贸易持续顺差,但两国都偶尔发生衰退,近年来两国的年增长率都特别强劲。更多关于日本贸易顺差的报导,

p374.original: Watch this video on whether or not trade deficit is good for the economy.

p375.original: The sheer size and persistence of the U.S. trade deficits and inflows of foreign capital since the 1980s are a legitimate cause for concern. The huge U.S. economy will not be destabilized by an outflow of international capital as easily as, say, the comparatively tiny economies of Thailand and Indonesia were in 1997–1998. Even an economy that is not knocked down, however, can still be shaken. American policymakers should certainly be paying attention to those cases where a pattern of extensive and sustained current account deficits and foreign borrowing has gone badly—if only as a cautionary tale.
p375.zh: 自1980年代以来,美国贸易赤字和外国资本流入的规模和持续程度是引起人们关注的正当原因。巨大的美国经济不会像1997-1998年泰国和印度尼西亚的相对小经济体那样轻易地因国际资本外流而动摇。 然而,即使经济没有崩溃,也仍然可能动摇。 美国决策者当然应该注意那些长期、大量经常账户赤字和外国借贷模式严重(如果只是作为警告的话)的情况。

p376.original: Are trade surpluses always beneficial? Considering Japan since the 1990s.
p376.zh: 贸易顺差是否始终是有利的?考虑日本自1990年代以来的情况。

p377.original: Perhaps no economy around the world is better known for its trade surpluses than Japan. Since 1990, the size of these surpluses has often been near $100 billion per year. When Japan’s economy was growing vigorously in the 1960s and 1970s, many, especially non-economists, described its large trade surpluses either a cause or a result of its robust economic health. However, from a standpoint of economic growth, Japan’s economy has been teetering in and out of recession since 1990, with real GDP growth averaging only about 1% per year, and an unemployment rate that has been creeping higher. Clearly, a whopping trade surplus is no guarantee of economic good health.
p377.zh: 也许世界上没有哪个经济体比日本更能以贸易顺差闻名。 自1990年以来,这些盈余的数额往往每年接近1 000亿美元。1960年代和1970年代日本经济强劲增长时,许多人,特别是非经济家,描述了其巨大的贸易盈余,无论是因为经济健康强劲的原因还是结果。 然而,从经济增长的角度来看,日本经济自1990年以来一直在陷入衰退之中和退出衰退,实际GDP年均增长率只有1 % , 失业率也不断上升。 显然,贸易顺差的减少并不能保证经济健康。

p378.original: Instead, Japan’s trade surplus reflects that Japan has a very high rate of domestic savings, more than the Japanese economy can invest domestically, and so it invests the extra funds abroad. In Japan’s slow economy, consumption of imports is relatively low, and the growth of consumption is relatively slow. Thus, Japan’s exports continually exceed its imports, leaving the trade surplus continually high. Recently, Japan’s trade surpluses began to deteriorate. In 2013, Japan ran a trade deficit due to the high cost of imported oil. By 2015, Japan again had a surplus and continues to run one today.
p378.zh: 相反,日本的贸易顺差反映出日本国内储蓄率非常高,超过日本经济可以在国内投资,因此将额外资金投资到国外. 在日本经济缓慢的情况下,进口消费相对较低,消费增长相对缓慢. 因此,日本的出口继续超过其进口,使贸易顺差继续高涨。 最近,日本的贸易顺差开始恶化.2013年,日本因进口石油成本高而出现贸易逆差. 到2015年,日本再次出现盈余,今天继续维持1个.

p380.original: Trade surpluses are no guarantee of economic health, and trade deficits are no guarantee of economic weakness. Either trade deficits or trade surpluses can work out well or poorly, depending on whether a government wisely invests the corresponding flows of financial capital.
p380.zh: 贸易盈余不能保证经济健康,贸易逆差也不能保证经济疲软.贸易逆差或贸易顺差都可能表现良好或不佳,这取决于政府是否明智地投资相应的金融资本流动。

p382.original:
For each of the following, indicate which type of government spending would justify a budget deficit and which would not.

Increased federal spending on Medicare
Increased spending on education
Increased spending on the space program
Increased spending on airports and air traffic control
p382.zh: 对于以下每一项,请说明哪些类型的政府支出是预算赤字的正当理由,哪些则不是。增加联邦医疗保障支出 增加教育支出 增加空间方案支出 增加机场和空中交通管制支出

p383.original:
Increased federal spending on Medicare may not increase productivity, so a budget deficit is not justified.
Increased spending on education will increase productivity and foster greater economic growth, so a budget deficit is justified.
Increased spending on the space program may not increase productivity, so a budget deficit is not justified.
Increased spending on airports and air traffic control will increase productivity and foster greater economic growth, so a budget deficit is justified.
p383.zh: 联邦增加的医疗保险开支可能不会提高生产力,因此预算赤字是没有道理的.增加教育开支将提高生产力,促进更大的经济增长,因此预算赤字是合理的。增加空间方案支出可能不会提高生产力,因此预算赤字是没有道理的。增加机场和空中交通管制开支将提高生产力,促进更大的经济增长,因此预算赤字是合理的。

p384.original: How did large trade deficits hurt the East Asian countries in the mid 1980s? (Recall that trade deficits are equivalent to inflows of financial capital from abroad.)
p384.zh: 1980年代中期,巨额贸易赤字对东亚国家有何伤害?(回顾贸易赤字相当于国外金融资本的流入。 )

p385.original: Foreign investors worried about repayment so they began to pull money out of these countries. The money can be pulled out of stock and bond markets, real estate, and banks.
p385.zh: 外国投资者担心还款,于是他们开始从这些国家抽出资金.这笔钱可以从股票和债券市场、房地产和银行中提取。

p386.original: Describe a scenario in which a trade surplus benefits an economy and one in which a trade surplus is occurring in an economy that performs poorly. What key factor or factors are making the difference in the outcome that results from a trade surplus?
p386.zh: 描述一种情景,即贸易盈余有利于一个经济体,而贸易盈余发生在一个表现不佳的经济体。哪些关键因素或因素使贸易顺差产生的结果有所变化?

p387.original: A rapidly growing trade surplus could result from a number of factors, so you would not want to be too quick to assume a specific cause. However, if the choice is between whether the economy is in recession or growing rapidly, the answer would have to be recession. In a recession, demand for all goods, including imports, has declined; however, demand for exports from other countries has not necessarily altered much, so the result is a larger trade surplus.
p387.zh: 贸易顺差的迅速增长可能来自一些因素,所以你不想太快地承担一个具体的原因。 然而,如果选择是经济处于衰退还是迅速增长,答案必须是衰退。 在经济衰退中,对所有商品的需求,包括进口,都有所下降;然而,对其他国家出口的需求并不一定发生很大变化,因此结果是贸易顺差增加。

p389.original: When is a trade deficit likely to work out well for an economy? When is it likely to work out poorly?
p389.zh: 贸易逆差何时才能为经济带来良好效果?什么时候才有好结果?

p390.original: Does a trade surplus help to guarantee strong economic growth?
p390.zh: 贸易顺差是否有助于保证强劲的经济增长?

p392.original: What is more important, a country’s current account balance or GDP growth? Why?
p392.zh: 更重要的是,一个国家的经常账户余额或国内生产总值的增长? 为什么?

p396.original: The Difference between Level of Trade and the Trade Balance
p396.zh: 贸易水平与贸易平衡之间的差异

p397.original: A nation’s level of trade may at first sound like much the same issue as the balance of trade, but these two are actually quite separate. It is perfectly possible for a country to have a very high level of trade—measured by its exports of goods and services as a share of its GDP—while it also has a near-balance between exports and imports. A high level of trade indicates that the nation exports a good portion of its production. It is also possible for a country’s trade to be a relatively low share of GDP, relative to global averages, but for the imbalance between its exports and its imports to be quite large. We emphasized this general theme earlier in Measuring Trade Balances, which offered some illustrative figures on trade levels and balances.
p397.zh: 一个国家的贸易水平起初可能听起来与贸易平衡问题大致相同,但这两个问题实际上是相当独立的。一个国家完全有可能拥有很高的贸易水平——以它的货物和劳务出口占其国内生产总值的比例来衡量——同时它也几乎在进出口之间保持平衡。高水平的贸易表明,该国出口了很大一部分生产。一个国家的贸易在国内生产总值中所占的份额相对全球平均水平而言也有可能较低,但其出口与进口之间的不平衡程度却相当大。 我们早些时候在《衡量贸易平衡》中强调了这个总主题,它提供了贸易水平和平衡的一些说明性数字。

p398.original: A country’s level of trade tells how much of its production it exports. We measure this by the percent of exports out of GDP. It indicates the degree of an economy's globalization. Some countries, such as Germany, have a high level of trade—they export almost 50% of their total production. The balance of trade tells us if the country is running a trade surplus or trade deficit. A country can have a low level of trade but a high trade deficit. (For example, the United States only exports around 10% of its GDP, but it has a trade deficit of over $600 billion.)
p398.zh: 一个国家的贸易水平说明它有多少产品出口。 我们用占GDP出口的百分比来衡量这一点。 它表明一个经济体的全球化程度。 一些国家,如德国,贸易水平很高——它们的出口几乎占其总产量的50%。贸易的平衡告诉我们,该国是否出现贸易顺差或贸易逆差。一个国家的贸易水平可能较低,但贸易赤字却很高。(例如,美国只出口其国内生产总值的10%左右,但其贸易赤字超过6 000亿美元。 )

p399.original: Three factors strongly influence a nation’s level of trade: the size of its economy, its geographic location, and its history of trade. Large economies like the United States can do much of their trading internally, while small economies like Sweden have less ability to provide what they want internally and tend to have higher ratios of exports and imports to GDP. Nations that are neighbors tend to trade more, since costs of transportation and communication are lower. Moreover, some nations have long and established patterns of international trade, while others do not.
p399.zh: 三个因素对一个国家的贸易水平具有很大影响:其经济规模、地理位置和贸易历史。象美国这样的大经济体可以做大部分内部贸易,而象瑞典这样的小经济体提供内部所希望的东西的能力较低,而且其出口和进口与国内生产总值的比率往往较高。邻国的贸易往往较多,因为运输和通信费用较低。 此外,一些国家长期存在国际贸易模式,而另一些国家则没有。

p400.original: Consequently, a relatively small economy like Sweden, with many nearby trading partners across Europe and a long history of foreign trade, has a high level of trade. Brazil and India, which are fairly large economies that have often sought to inhibit trade in recent decades, have lower levels of trade; whereas, the United States and Japan are extremely large economies that have comparatively few nearby trading partners. Both countries actually have quite low levels of trade by world standards. The ratio of exports to GDP in either the United States or in Japan is about half of the world average.
p400.zh: 因此,像瑞典这样的相对较小的经济,在全欧洲有许多附近的贸易伙伴,外贸历史悠久,贸易水平很高。 巴西和印度是相当庞大的经济体,近几十年来经常试图抑制贸易,贸易水平较低;而美国和日本是极为庞大的经济体,相邻的贸易伙伴相对较少。两国实际上的贸易水平按世界标准计算都相当低。 美国或日本的出口与国内生产总值的比率约为世界平均水平的一半。

p401.original: The balance of trade is a separate issue from the level of trade. The United States has a low level of trade, but had enormous trade deficits for most years from the mid-1980s into the 2000s. Japan has a low level of trade by world standards, but has typically shown large trade surpluses in recent decades. Nations like Germany and the United Kingdom have medium to high levels of trade by world standards, but Germany had a moderate trade surplus in 2020, while the United Kingdom had a moderate trade deficit. Their trade picture was roughly in balance in the late 1990s. Sweden had a high level of trade and a moderate trade surplus in 2020, while Canada had a high level of trade and a moderate trade deficit that same year.
p401.zh: 贸易平衡与贸易水平是不同的问题。 美国的贸易水平很低,但从1980年代中期到2000年代,贸易赤字大都很大。 日本的贸易水平按世界标准计算较低,但近几十年来通常出现大量贸易顺差。 德国和英国等国家按照世界标准的贸易水平中高,但德国2020年的贸易顺差不大,而英国的贸易逆差也比较小.1990年代后期,它们的贸易情况大致保持平衡。 瑞典在2020年贸易水平较高,贸易顺差适度,而加拿大同年贸易水平较高,贸易逆差适度.

p402.original: In short, it is quite possible for nations with a relatively low level of trade, expressed as a percentage of GDP, to have relatively large trade deficits. It is also quite possible for nations with a near balance between exports and imports to worry about the consequences of high levels of trade for the economy. It is not inconsistent to believe that a high level of trade is potentially beneficial to an economy, because of the way it allows nations to play to their comparative advantages, and to also be concerned about any macroeconomic instability caused by a long-term pattern of large trade deficits. The following Clear It Up feature discusses how this sort of dynamic played out in Colonial India.
p402.zh: 简言之,贸易水平相对较低的国家,以国内生产总值的百分比表示,贸易赤字可能相对较大。出口和进口之间接近平衡的国家也很有可能担心高水平贸易对经济的后果。认为高水平的贸易有可能对经济有利,因为贸易使各国能够发挥它们的相对优势,而且关切长期贸易赤字模式造成的任何宏观经济不稳定,这并非不一致。 以下的 Clear It Up 特性讨论这种动态如何在殖民地印度发挥出来.

p403.original: Are trade surpluses always beneficial? Considering Colonial India.
p403.zh: 贸易顺差是否始终是有利的?考虑殖民地印度。

p404.original: India was formally under British rule from 1858 to 1947. During that time, India consistently had trade surpluses with Great Britain. Anyone who believes that trade surpluses are a sign of economic strength and dominance while trade deficits are a sign of economic weakness must find this pattern odd, since it would mean that colonial India was successfully dominating and exploiting Great Britain for almost a century—which was not true.
p404.zh: 印度从1858年到1947年正式处于英国统治之下.在此期间,印度一直与大不列颠保持贸易顺差.任何认为贸易盈余是经济实力和支配地位的标志,而贸易赤字是经济疲软的标志的人必须发现这种模式是奇怪的,因为这将意味着殖民印度成功地统治和剥削大不列颠将近一个世纪了,这不是真的。

p405.original: Instead, India’s trade surpluses with Great Britain meant that each year there was an overall flow of financial capital from India to Great Britain. In India, many heavily criticized this financial capital flow as the “drain,” and they viewed eliminating the financial capital drain as one of the many reasons why India would benefit from achieving independence.
p405.zh: 相反,印度与大不列颠的贸易顺差意味着,每年从印度到大不列颠的金融资本总的流量。在印度,许多人强烈批评这种金融资本流动是“人才外流 ” , 他们认为消除金融资本外流是印度从实现独立中受益的诸多原因之一。

p406.zh: 关于贸易平衡的最后想法

p407.original: Trade deficits can be a good or a bad sign for an economy, and trade surpluses can be a good or a bad sign. Even a trade balance of zero—which just means that a nation is neither a net borrower nor lender in the international economy—can be either a good or bad sign. The fundamental economic question is not whether a nation’s economy is borrowing or lending at all, but whether the particular borrowing or lending in the particular economic conditions of that country makes sense.
p407.zh: 贸易逆差可以是经济的好兆头,也可以是经济的坏兆头,贸易盈余可以是好兆头,也可以是坏兆头.即使是零贸易平衡——这仅仅意味着一个国家既不是国际经济的净借款人也不是贷款人——也不可能是一个好或坏的迹象。根本的经济问题不是一个国家的经济是借贷,而是该国特定经济条件下的特定借贷是否合理。

p408.original: It is interesting to reflect on how public attitudes toward trade deficits and surpluses might change if we could somehow change the labels that people and the news media affix to them. If we called a trade deficit “attracting foreign financial capital”—which accurately describes what a trade deficit means—then trade deficits might look more attractive. Conversely, if we called a trade surplus “shipping financial capital abroad”—which accurately captures what a trade surplus does—then trade surpluses might look less attractive. Either way, the key to understanding trade balances is to understand the relationships between flows of trade and flows of international payments, and what these relationships imply about the causes, benefits, and risks of different kinds of trade balances. The first step along this journey of understanding is to move beyond knee-jerk reactions to terms like “trade surplus,” “trade balance,” and “trade deficit.”
p408.zh: 思考一下,如果我们能够改变人们和新闻媒体所贴的标签,公众对贸易赤字和盈余的态度会如何改变,这很有趣。 如果我们把贸易赤字称为 " 吸收外国金融资本 " ——这准确地说明了贸易赤字的含义——那么贸易赤字看起来可能更有吸引力。 相反,如果我们将贸易盈余称为 " 将金融资本汇往国外 " ——这准确地反映了贸易盈余的作用——那么贸易盈余看起来可能不那么具有吸引力。 无论如何,理解贸易平衡的关键是了解贸易流动与国际支付流动之间的关系,以及这种关系对不同类型贸易平衡的原因、好处和风险意味着什么。沿着这一谅解之路迈出的第一步是超越“贸易盈余 ” 、 “ 贸易平衡 ” 和 “ 贸易赤字 ” 。

p409.original: More than Meets the Eye in the Congo

p410.original: Now that you see the big picture, you undoubtedly realize that all of the economic choices you make, such as depositing savings or investing in an international mutual fund, do influence the flow of goods and services as well as the flows of money around the world.
p410.zh: 现在你看到大局,你无疑意识到,你所做的所有经济选择,如储蓄或投资国际共同基金,确实影响着商品和服务的流动以及世界各地的资金流动。

p411.original: You now know that a trade surplus does not necessarily tell us whether an economy is performing well or not. The Democratic Republic of the Congo ran a trade surplus in 2013, as we learned in the beginning of the chapter. Yet its current account balance was –$2.8 billion. However, the return of political stability and the rebuilding in the aftermath of the civil war there has meant a flow of investment and financial capital into the country. In this case, a negative current account balance means the country is being rebuilt—and that is a good thing.
p411.zh: 你现在知道,贸易顺差并不一定告诉我们一个经济体是否表现良好。 正如我们在本章开头所了解到的那样,刚果民主共和国在2013年出现了贸易顺差。 然而,其经常账户余额为28亿美元。 然而,政治稳定的恢复和该国内战后的重建意味着投资和金融资本流入该国。 在这种情况下,经常账户负结余意味着该国正在重建——这是一件好事。

p413.original: There is a difference between the level of a country’s trade and the balance of trade. The government measures its level of trade by the percentage of exports out of GDP, or the size of the economy. Small economies that have nearby trading partners and a history of international trade will tend to have higher levels of trade. Larger economies with few nearby trading partners and a limited history of international trade will tend to have lower levels of trade. The level of trade is different from the trade balance. The level of trade depends on a country’s history of trade, its geography, and the size of its economy. A country’s balance of trade is the dollar difference between its exports and imports.
p413.zh: 一个国家的贸易水平和贸易平衡有差别。 政府用出口占国内生产总值的百分比或经济规模来衡量其贸易水平。拥有附近贸易伙伴和国际贸易历史的小型经济体的贸易水平往往较高。规模较大的经济体,附近贸易伙伴很少,国际贸易历史有限,贸易水平往往较低。贸易水平不同于贸易平衡.贸易水平取决于一个国家的贸易历史、地理和经济规模。一个国家的贸易平衡是其进出口之间的美元差额。

p414.original: Trade deficits and trade surpluses are not necessarily good or bad—it depends on the circumstances. Even if a country is borrowing, if it invests that money in productivity-boosting investments it can lead to an improvement in long-term economic growth.
p414.zh: 贸易赤字和贸易顺差不一定是好是坏,这取决于具体情况。 即使一个国家在借贷,如果将这笔钱投资于提高生产力的投资,它也能导致长期经济增长的改善。

p416.original: The United States exports 14% of GDP while Germany exports about 50% of its GDP. Explain what that means.
p416.zh: 美国的出口占国内生产总值的14%,德国的出口约占其国内生产总值的50%。解释这是什么意思。

p417.original: Germany has a higher level of trade than the United States. The United States has a large domestic economy so it has a large volume of internal trade.
p417.zh: 德国的贸易水平高于美国. 美国国内经济规模庞大,因此国内贸易量很大。

p418.original:
Explain briefly whether each of the following would be more likely to lead to a higher level of trade for an economy, or a greater imbalance of trade for an economy.

Living in an especially large country
Having a domestic investment rate much higher than the domestic savings rate
Having many other large economies geographically nearby
Having an especially large budget deficit
Having countries with a tradition of strong protectionist legislation shutting out imports
p418.zh: 简单解释一下,以下每一种情况是否都更可能导致一个经济体的贸易水平提高,或者一个经济体的贸易不平衡加剧。生活在一个特别大的国家,国内投资率比国内储蓄率高得多 邻近的许多其他大型经济体 预算赤字特别大 传统上有强有力的保护主义立法的国家 将进口货物拒之门外

p419.original: A large economy tends to have lower levels of international trade, because it can do more of its trade internally, but this has little impact on its trade imbalance.
p419.zh: 大型经济体的国际贸易水平往往较低,因为它可以更多地进行内部贸易,但这对其贸易不平衡的影响不大。

p420.original: An imbalance between domestic physical investment and domestic saving (including government and private saving) will always lead to a trade imbalance, but has little to do with the level of trade.
p420.zh: 国内实物投资与国内储蓄(包括政府和私人储蓄)之间的不平衡总是会导致贸易不平衡,但与贸易水平几乎没有关系。

p421.original: Many large trading partners nearby geographically increases the level of trade, but has little impact one way or the other on a trade imbalance.
p421.zh: 附近的许多大型贸易伙伴在地理上提高了贸易水平,但对贸易不平衡几乎没有任何影响。

p422.original: The answer here is not obvious. An especially large budget deficit means a large demand for financial capital which, according to the national saving and investment identity, makes it somewhat more likely that there will be a need for an inflow of foreign capital, which means a trade deficit.
p422.zh: 这里的答案并不明显。特别庞大的预算赤字意味着对金融资本的大量需求,根据国民储蓄和投资特征,这使得外国资本的流入更加可能,这意味着贸易赤字。

p423.original: A strong tradition of discouraging trade certainly reduces the level of trade. However, it does not necessarily say much about the balance of trade, since this is determined by both imports and exports, and by national levels of physical investment and savings.
p423.zh: 遏制贸易的强烈传统无疑会降低贸易水平。 然而,它不一定多说贸易平衡,因为贸易平衡既取决于进出口,也取决于国家的实际投资和储蓄水平。

p425.original: What three factors will determine whether a nation has a higher or lower share of trade relative to its GDP?
p425.zh: 哪些因素将决定一个国家的贸易在国内生产总值中所占的份额是较高还是较低?

p426.original: What is the difference between trade deficits and balance of trade?
p426.zh: 贸易逆差与贸易平衡有何区别?

p428.original: Will nations that are more involved in foreign trade tend to have higher trade imbalances, lower trade imbalances, or is the pattern unpredictable?
p428.zh: 更多参与对外贸易的国家是否倾向于贸易不平衡程度较高、贸易不平衡程度较低,或者这种模式是否难以预测?

p429.original: Some economists warn that the persistent trade deficits and a negative current account balance that the United States has run will be a problem in the long run. Do you agree or not? Explain your answer.
p429.zh: 一些经济学家警告说,从长远来看,美国持续的贸易赤字和经常账户负结余将是一个问题。 你同意还是不同意?解释你的答案。

c0.original: We are all part of the global financial system, which includes many different currencies. (Credit: modification of "Money from around the world" by Images Money/Flickr, CC BY 2.0)
c0.zh: 我们都是全球金融体系的一部分,其中包括许多不同的货币。(credit:由Images Money/Flickr,CC BY 2.0对"来自世界各地的钱"的修改).

c2.original: (a) The current account balance and the merchandise trade balance in billions of dollars from 1960 to 2020. The merchandise trade balance is the trade balance on goods only. If the lines are above zero dollars, the United States was running a positive trade balance and current account balance. If the lines fall below zero dollars, the United States is running a trade deficit and a deficit in its current account balance. (b) This shows the same items—trade balance and current account balance—in relationship to the size of the U.S. economy, or GDP, from 1960 to 2020.
c2.zh: (a) 1960年至2020年经常账户余额和商品贸易余额(以10亿美元计)。商品贸易平衡只是货物的贸易平衡。 如果项目金额高于零美元,美国的贸易顺差和经常账户顺差。 如果项目低于零美元,美国经常账户余额就会出现贸易逆差和赤字。(b) 这表明,1960年至2020年期间,与美国经济规模或国内生产总值有关的项目——贸易平衡和经常账户平衡。

c3.original: (figures as a percentage of GDP, Source: http://data.worldbank.org/indicator/BN.CAB.XOKA.GD.ZS)
c3.zh: (数字占国内生产总值的百分比,资料来源:http://data.worldbank.org/indicator/BN.CAB.XOKA.GD.ZS)

c5.original: Each element of the current account balance involves a flow of financial payments between countries. The top line shows exports of goods and services leaving the home country; the second line shows the money that the home country receives for those exports. The third line shows imports that the home country receives; the fourth line shows the payments that the home country sent abroad in exchange for these imports.
c5.zh: 经常账户余额的每个要素都涉及国家间的金融支付流动。上行显示货物和劳务的出口离开母国;第二行显示母国为这些出口获得的资金。 第三行显示母国收到的进口品;第四行显示母国为换取这些进口品而向国外的付款.
